sections.name: New
notes: GEAR AWAKENING: awaken any weapon, armour or shield up to 5 stars. Choose one of 11 paths (Ember, Frost, Storm, Void, Dawn, Titan; Bulwark, Warding, Vigor, Shadow, Thorn). Traits unlock at stars III and V.
Awakening stones come from salvaging uncommon+ gear or from TRANSMUTE (6 scrap + 1 shard + 50 G). REFORGE changes a path and keeps the stars.
RELIC and ARTIFACT pages in the Character menu: all 42 of each, with found count, bonuses and equip from the codex.
PATCH NOTES page with an update check against the GitHub releases.
Regions, realms and a shared world on the multiplayer server.

sections.name: UI
notes: Every menu and page uses the title menu's style: navy panels, gold frames and the amber selection bar with cream text.
The HTML overlay panels around the game screen are removed; the in-screen HUD shows instead.
Text that was too wide for the screen is fitted or shortened instead of running off the edge.
Realm select and expansion map layouts no longer overlap.

sections.name: Fixes
notes: Title screen no longer starts blank while assets load; it shows LOADING %.
The game is centred and no longer clipped in full-window mode.
Quest board and home screen no longer crash on missing data.

sections.name: Changes
notes: FULL DETAIL sprite redesign: new heroes, townsfolk, monsters and field props.
Retro 8-bit item icons at true 16x16 resolution.
Title screen shows the Lanterns of Aelmoor key art.
